title: In a commutative triangle, affineness of one leg and of the other diagonal gives affineness of the third morphism
author: The Stacks Project Authors
work: Stacks Project — Morphisms of Algebraic Stacks
source_version: Stacks Project git a04446e57ec1 (2026-07-28); file stacks-morphisms.tex; corpus local snapshot 20261012
difficulty_reason: The counted statement shows that in a commutative triangle of morphisms of algebraic stacks, affineness of one leg together with affineness of the diagonal of the other leg forces affineness of the composite (author lemma at source lines 2359-2371, label lemma-affine-permanence). The proof (source lines 2373-2387) identifies the morphism as the composite of the graph and the second projection, obtains affineness of the projection by base change and of the graph as a base change of the given diagonal, and concludes by composition permanence (proof lines 2374-2385). The identification of the graph as a base change of the diagonal is the content. H2.
